latestTerminalSummary:
**Opus Round 31 verdict: pass. All 14 scores are 9, in both light and dark.** This is one reviewer's result; the second consecutive joint pass still depends on pairing it with Sol's Round 31 report.

| Category | Light | Dark |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Typography | 9 | 9 |
| Composition and spacing | 9 | 9 |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 9 | 9 |
| Component visual consistency | 9 | 9 |
| Responsive visual polish | 9 | 9 |
| Save discoverability and feedback | 9 | 9 |

**Same interface as Round 30:** against c115, the runtime/validation scope diff is empty with no exclusions. From 42 to c115 only the two test files changed, and assets are still `aa7a00afd7a2`. Nothing invalidates the candidate.

**What I checked live:**
- **Filter-only miss (the gap left in Round 30):** `/search?tag=Review%20empty` renders correctly at all 8 width/scheme pairs: matching headline and helper, 12px rhythm, a 44px Clear filters button, no overflow. I clicked Clear filters at 320 light, 390 dark and 1280 dark. Each time it returned to the welcome screen with the header and the `/new` button intact.
- **All five empty states:** 40 views, all in the same layout with correct actions. Some of these were measured in viewport-sized frames rather than real resizes; representative ones were confirmed on the real tab.
- **Your three reported defects:**
  - The tag-color check badge corner now follows the cell's corner with an even gap; I found no stray pixels when magnified 6×.
  - Tag labels are compact, with separate 32px (desktop) or 44px (phone) action buttons.
  - The header Save reads "Saved / Unsaved" with a floppy icon and the word "Save" at every width. Its position never moves, including when scrolled deep into a dirty editor. I tested a temporary title change at all 8 pairs and restored it without saving.
- **Save outcomes:** pending, error and retry come only from the parent's existing screenshots on this build. I did not run a real save, error or retry myself.

**Remaining minor issues (none lowers a score):**
- In the Stored state panel, "Save state" stays a highlighted primary button even with no edits, unlike the header Save, which goes quiet when clean. This is the most visible inconsistency left.
- On the small desktop color cells, the check badge covers part of the color dot.
- Add and Settings still label their back link "Library" instead of "Starred".
- Every Activity row repeats "Artifact version saved."
- Share at 640×360 has a short scroll area.
- The unselected dark-mode radio is a grey disc.

**Not covered:**
- I couldn't get the code-completion popup to open, so it wasn't checked this round.
- Populated Shared and Activity weren't viewed at phone widths.
- The card posture popover wasn't opened.
- No physical phone, Safari or accessibility testing.

Three of my own probes (a zoom, a scroll, a double key press) briefly disturbed the page; I discarded those frames and didn't count them as defects. Nothing was saved or changed, the editor ended "Saved" with tags unchanged, and both of my tabs are closed.

The full report is at `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-31-opus-followup.md`.
